feedback.problem:
Find the scale factor of the transformation represented by the rotation-scaling matrix
$A=[\begin{aligned}\sqrt{5} & -2 \\ 2 & \sqrt{5}\end{aligned}].$
feedback.worked_solution:
The scale factor $r$ of the rotation-scaling matrix $[\begin{aligned}a & -b \\ b & a\end{aligned}]$ can be found using the formula 

$$
r=\sqrt{det(A)}=\sqrt{{a}^{2}+{b}^{2}}.
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}r & =\sqrt{det(A)} \\  & =\sqrt{(\sqrt{5})^{2}+(2)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{5+4} \\  & =\sqrt{9} \\  & =3.\end{aligned}
$$
